npcs.full_name: Petra (surname never given on-screen; name badge reads "PETRA — PRODUCTION")
npcs.role: Sign-up coordinator; runs sign-up, full disclosure, and release-form collection

appearance.clothing: faded Shady Productions polo, headset, practical sandals

personality.speech_pattern: precise, unhurried Central European English; flat and complete regardless of interruption

dialogue.greeting: Hi. Yes. Sign-up is here. The show is called The Bacchanus Beach Beatdown. It is a trivia contest. The trivia is in Czech. All of it. Every question. There is no translator — we cut that from the budget in 2011.
idle_chatter: You will be strapped into a portable toilet. The portable toilet is attached to a pneumatic catapult. Three incorrect answers and the catapult fires you into the river. The river is The Bacchanus. It is not clean. It has never been clean. I want to be clear that I am not exaggerating for the show.
That is not a camera. That is a monitor for the camera. It is showing you the beach behind you.
dialogue.transaction: These are the release forms. They are in Czech. By signing, you waive the right to pursue us for injury, drowning, contamination, and 'reputational consequence in perpetuity across all media, known and not yet invented.' Would you like me to read them aloud in English? I am happy to. It takes eleven minutes.
dialogue.farewell: You're signed up. Strap-in is at the catapult. Jaxson will call your names — well, he will call 'contestants.' He does not have your names either.

special_triggers.not_an_obstacle_course: It is not an obstacle course. There are no obstacles. There is a toilet, and then there is the river.
special_triggers.not_downplaying: I am not downplaying it. I am describing it.
special_triggers.did_not_let_finish: You did not let me finish.
special_triggers.signing_for_others_note: I want it noted for the record that this is not legally how that works.
special_triggers.player_lingers: No rush. The forms don't expire. The tide — there is no tide, it's a river, but the offer doesn't expire either.
special_triggers.checkout_loss_branch: Please sign here to confirm receipt of one [1] second-place prize.
special_triggers.checkout_second_place_clarification: Second place is everyone who did not win. That's — however many of you are standing here. You're all tied for it.
special_triggers.return_visit: Back again. New form, same river. Would you like me to read this one aloud too? Still eleven minutes.

services.description: Free (signature required). Full, accurate disclosure of every quest mechanic before commitment; gates entry into the trivia gauntlet.

npc_to_npc.description: Jaxson defers to Petra on anything involving disclosure, forms, or safety and never improvises around her. Petra and Janek share mutual, easy respect — she discloses everything to him the same way she discloses it to everyone, and he trusts her completely. Jaxson holds Janek in mild, carefully concealed awe (Janek is the only contestant in eleven seasons who has never needed him for anything). Hamstradamus shares podium duties with Jaxson on filming days — Jaxson hosts, Hamstradamus prophesies; professional courtesy only. Zdenka, Standa, and Rosta operate independently along fauxst_beach and have no scripted interaction with the principal cast.
